subject: Geo-fence & retention controls for Cloudfolio marketplace listing
messages:
From: Amy Singh <amy.singh@cloudfolio.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Geo-fence & retention controls for Cloudfolio listing

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're preparing the listing paperwork for Cloudfolio's marketplace catalog and need to lock down a few things around data residency, retention, and deletion so we can satisfy procurement and our security team. A couple of concrete asks: 

- Can Redwood guarantee per-customer region pinning for marketplace customers across AWS/GCP/Azure (i.e., EU accounts always stay in eu-west/GCP-europe/Azure-north?)
- What are the options and contractable SLAs for data deletion after contract termination? Specifically: primary data, backups, and audit logs — what timelines can we offer?
- Any caveats where cross-region failover or backups may leave short-lived copies in a different jurisdiction?

I'm attaching our high-level requirements spreadsheet so you can map it to your offering. Would love a short call with the partner/sales lead and legal to get contract wording.

Attachments: [attachment: marketplace-data-specs.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,
Amy Singh\Partnerships\Cloudfolio
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Amy Singh <amy.singh@cloudfolio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Geo-fence & retention controls for Cloudfolio listing

Hi Amy — thanks, got the spreadsheet. High level here (I'll loop Ben and Marissa for legal/contract language):

- Region pinning: yes — we support per-customer region pinning at the account/route level for supported provider regions across AWS/GCP/Azure. We can list EU-only, US-only, or hybrid mappings per account.
- Deletion SLAs: we offer configurable deletion windows that are contractable. Typical options we put in marketplace deals: immediate purge (on-termination), 30 days, 90 days, 365 days for retained backups (you pick based on compliance needs). Primary storage deletion can be immediate or SLA-based; backups and logs are handled separately.
- Cross-region caveat: cross-region backups/failover are optional; if enabled for resilience, we can restrict to provider-region pairs (e.g., GCP europe -> GCP europe-west1 replica) but not cross-cloud. If you require strict geo-fencing (no cross-country copies), we need that in the config and contract.

I'll attach a short summary and loop Ben (partner engineering) for a recommended account->region mapping. Marissa from legal will draft clause suggestions.

Best,
Jordan
Attachments: [attachment: redwood-residency-summary.pdf (pdf)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Amy Singh <amy.singh@cloudfolio.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Geo-fence & retention controls for Cloudfolio listing

Amy / Jordan — tagging in recommended config mapping and a few operational notes below. Proposal (high-level):

- EU commercial accounts -> AWS eu-west-1 or GCP europe-west1; keep backups in same provider and region (replicas only within the same cloud region).
- US commercial accounts -> Azure eastus2 / AWS us-east-2 as preferred.
- Logs & monitoring: ingestion occurs in-region, but aggregated metrics can be forwarded to a central workspace; raw logs remain in-region for retention windows you pick.

Operational caveats:
- If you opt into cross-region disaster recovery, short-lived replication snapshots may exist in a secondary region for up to 48 hours during failover. We can document this as an exception.
- Deletion pipeline: primary storage deletion is triggered by the termination workflow; backups are tombstoned and then purged per the retention SLA — typical purge job runs hourly with a separate long-term deletion queue for snapshots.

Next steps: if you confirm desired SLAs for (a) primary data, (b) backups, (c) audit logs, we will produce a CSV mapping accounts -> provider/region and highlight any gaps.

Attachments: [attachment: proposed-mapping.csv (csv)]

Thanks,
Ben
Partner Solutions\Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amy Singh <amy.singh@cloudfolio.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Geo-fence & retention controls for Cloudfolio listing

Hi Amy — copying suggested contract language snippets below so your procurement can start redlining. These are intentionally short to slot into a marketplace terms addendum: 

1) Data Residency. Customer accounts may be provisioned to be stored and processed only within the geographic region(s) specified in the account configuration ("Designated Regions"). Redwood will not intentionally transfer Customer Data outside the Designated Regions except for (i) scheduled backups where Customer has opted into cross-region replication, or (ii) as required by law. 

2) Deletion & Retention. Upon termination or expiry of the Agreement, Redwood will: (a) commence deletion of Customer Data from primary storage within 24 hours of termination; (b) tombstone backups immediately and purge backups within the contractually-defined retention period (e.g., 30/90/365 days); (c) remove audit logs within the specified retention window or provide a certified extract if required for regulatory purposes.

3) Exception for Incident Recovery. Short-lived replication for disaster recovery may create transient copies in the secondary region for up to 48 hours; Redwood will notify Customer if such a failover occurs.

Please confirm which retention windows you'd like named in the addendum and whether Cloudfolio requires explicit language disallowing cross-cloud replication. If Cloudfolio wants DocuSign-ready text, we can prepare an addendum draft.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Amy Singh <amy.singh@cloudfolio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 13:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Geo-fence & retention controls for Cloudfolio listing

Thanks team — this is extremely helpful. A few clarifications from Cloudfolio security and procurement: 

- Preferred retention windows: primary data = immediate purge on termination; backups = 90 days; audit logs = 30 days (Cloudfolio policy).
- Geo requirement: EU commercial customers must be EU-only (no cross-cloud copies). US customers can accept single-cloud replica in same region.
- Disaster recovery: we will not opt into cross-cloud DR for EU accounts. For US we may enable intra-cloud DR (same provider, different AZ/region pair) — okay with the 48-hour transient exception.

Attached is Cloudfolio's security addendum with specifics. Procurement requests a DocuSign-ready addendum with the agreed retention windows and the EU-only clause. Can Redwood produce that? We aim to complete contracting by end of month.

Attachments: [attachment: Cloudfolio_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

Amy Singh
Head of Partnerships
Cloudfolio
